meta.title: Strickle
meta.description: Your pay agent: irregular income, a regular salary.

home.title: Home
home.emptyTitle: Your next salary will appear here
home.emptyBody: Once your first payment arrives, the agent shows the date, the amount and the rule behind it.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyBody: When the agent splits a payment or pays your salary, you see what it did, which rule applied and what you can still change.

boxes.title: Boxes
boxes.emptyTitle: Your boxes are not set up yet
boxes.emptyBody: Taxes, cash, emergency fund, salary and profit each get their own box once you finish setup.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emptyBody: You will pause the agent, change its rules and share a read-only view with your accountant from this screen.

verify.title: Verify
verify.emptyBody: Certificates of income are not issued yet. When they are, you will be able to check one here.

docs.title: Docs
docs.emptyBody: When it is, this page links to it. Until then, each rule the agent applies is shown next to the number it produces.

review.confirm: These percentages are my starting point

restore.body: Enter the recovery code you saved when you created your account.
restore.label: Recovery code

restore.mismatch: That code does not open your notices. Check that it belongs to this account.
restore.unverified: The code is valid. It is checked the first time your agent sends a notice.
restore.done: Your notices are restored on this device.

done.waiting: This can take a few minutes. You can go to your home now.

agent.title: The agent
agent.runningNote: The agent splits your deposits, pays your salary on its day and refreshes your plan.
agent.pausedNote: While paused, the agent cannot split deposits, pay your salary or refresh your plan, and it cannot apply changes to your plan. A private payment you sign yourself can still go through. Your boxes stay as they are.
agent.enclaveBlocked: The agent applies this change, so it can only be made while the agent is running. Resume it first.
agent.safetyNote: The agent stopped itself because a safety check failed: {codes}. It stays stopped and this app cannot restart it.
agent.limits: Your vault lets the agent move at most {cap} every {hours} hours.

autonomy.auto: Pay my salary automatically up to

rules.title: Rules of your boxes
rules.intro: These rules live in your vault, so the agent cannot change them. Making a rule stricter applies now. Making it looser waits at least a day, and you apply it yourself afterwards. That includes a lock date: it can be shortened after the wait, so it protects you from a hasty decision, not from yourself.
rules.looser: Looser: waits {hours} h. After that you apply it yourself.

view.title: Account view
view.publicBanner: Everything on this page is public on the Arc network. Anyone with this address can see it. The agent's plan and private notes are not shown.
view.noPayments: No payments have arrived in this account yet.
view.historyUnavailable: The payment history is not available right now. The balances above are read straight from the network.
view.error: This account could not be read. Try again in a moment.
view.notFound: This address is not a Strickle account.
view.shareIntro: Your accountant can read your boxes, their rules and the agent's payments with this link. It shows what is already public on the Arc network. It does not show your plan, and the link does not hide anything: anyone who has your account address can see the same data. It cannot be revoked.
view.keysIntro: Private notes can be shared with an accountant through a view key that only they hold. That is not active for ordinary accounts yet.
view.copyFailed: Select the link and copy it.
